verdict.rationale: Mollie clearly publishes API reference pages (e.g. the Payments API, Subscriptions API and Balances API references), but nothing in the evidence describes interactive features such as a 'try it' console, an in-browser request runner, or runnable code examples. A static reference and an llms.txt markdown mirror are adjacent capabilities and do not satisfy this story. The probe also found no public OpenAPI or Swagger file at any of the candidate paths, so there is no evidence of the interactive, runnable experience this story asks about.
